metrics.population_rule: Receipt date in activity window under explicit receipt basis; unique visible complaints.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown receipt dates excluded and disclosed.

metrics.population_rule: Known members with at least one permitted case event in activity window.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown member IDs excluded and disclosed.

metrics.population_rule: Supported same-episode subsequent complainant/representative contacts in window; deduplicate.
metrics.unknown_rule: Uncertain continuity or first-contact history separate.

metrics.population_rule: Unique complainant/authorised-representative contacts in window with supported same-continuing-problem linkage and strictly later timing than an evidenced prior case closure. Count each contact once across prior closures, episodes and copies; use deduplicated contact occurrence time.
metrics.unknown_rule: Uncertain identity, continuity, timing or closure evidence separate; absence under missing history is not zero. Review signal, not proof of defective resolution.

metrics.population_rule: Distinct known members associated with supported post-closure return contacts in window under contacts.post_closure_return eligibility.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown member references disclosed; a representative counts for the supported represented member, not as an extra member. No invented identity matching.

metrics.population_rule: Unique newly received internal complaint cases in window under explicit receipt basis, supported as arising from a post-closure return about the same continuing problem in an earlier case. Earlier and new case IDs differ; reopening the earlier case is not a new case. Return contact need not fall in the receipt window but must be evidenced by snapshot.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown receipt dates or unsupported return-to-new-case relationships excluded and disclosed; source copies and multiple prior closures do not multiply cases.

metrics.population_rule: Unique source-backed reopening transitions in window at transition time, linked to a supported same-problem post-closure return. Require an actual closed-to-reopened transition on that case after its closure and a return contact no later than the transition; deduplicate fact/source copies.
metrics.unknown_rule: Administrative reopenings without a supported member-return link excluded; uncertain timing/linkage separate. Repeated genuine transitions count separately, not repeated status snapshots.

metrics.population_rule: Visible latest sourced administrative state open/awaiting/reopened at endpoint; includes carry-in.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown historical states separate; no current-status backfill.

metrics.population_rule: Unique recorded seconds in window divided by 3600; do not include estimated duration.
metrics.unknown_rule: Missing duration excluded; partial coverage explicit.

metrics.population_rule: Unique separately estimated seconds in window divided by 3600.
metrics.unknown_rule: No replacement or duplicate of recorded work.

metrics.population_rule: Net unique payments/reversals for AFCA fee, external assistance and other complaint expense.
metrics.unknown_rule: Incomplete payment evidence yields partial subtotal, not full zero.

metrics.population_rule: Net unique compensation and settlement payment/reversal events in window.
metrics.unknown_rule: Requests/offers/approvals/invoices not cash.

metrics.population_rule: Union of eligible expense and remedy payments; excludes benefit/refund entitlements.
metrics.unknown_rule: Must be labelled combined cash; no hours or estimates.

metrics.population_rule: Latest supported applicable obligation amount less net payments/credits as of endpoint; exclude offers/requests.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown/conflicting amount excluded with coverage; overpayment flagged.

metrics.population_rule: Open cases by calendar-day age bands 0-7,8-30,31-60,61-90,91-180,>180 and unknown.
metrics.unknown_rule: Explicit receipt basis; all bands including unknown reconcile.

metrics.population_rule: Calendar-day age since latest supported reopening/open transition, separately from original age.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown spell start remains unknown.

metrics.population_rule: Supported closed cases in period: receipt to closure calendar days; exclude still-open cases.
metrics.unknown_rule: Denominator and missing endpoints disclosed.

metrics.population_rule: Sourced current ongoing dependency duration to snapshot; distinguish parallel waits and missing starts.
metrics.unknown_rule: No sum of parallel waits as elapsed case age.

metrics.population_rule: Union supported unresolved intervals per known member intersected with window; seconds/86400 with declared duration basis.
metrics.unknown_rule: Missing completion alone not proof of unresolved service; incomplete intervals separate.

metrics.population_rule: Union supported included case links under active-in-window or all-linked-to-date selection.
metrics.unknown_rule: Excluded/uncertain memberships not counted as included.

metrics.population_rule: Distinct known members in supported issue population.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown member IDs not silently complete.

metrics.population_rule: One sourced first problem-start event per supported episode in window; not every contact or complaint.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown starts excluded with coverage.

metrics.population_rule: Union supported issue population intersected with reconstructed open cases at endpoint.
metrics.unknown_rule: Historical resolved associations not silently current dependencies.

metrics.population_rule: Distinct formal external receipt/referral dates in window, not threats to escalate.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown receipt dates separate.

metrics.population_rule: External matters with supported non-closed state at snapshot.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown state distinct from open.

metrics.population_rule: Matters concluded in window by exclusive observed route; negotiation/conciliation/determination/withdrawn/other/unknown.
metrics.unknown_rule: Open matters excluded from closed-route denominator.

metrics.population_rule: One current evidenced external stage per matter at snapshot.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown stage is its own bucket.

metrics.population_rule: Open external matters by local-calendar days since external receipt; original complaint age separate.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown external receipt in unknown band.

metrics.population_rule: One declared standard-stream current fee level per known matter, not summed stages or linked internal cases.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown fee category not zero; do not add estimate to invoice/payment.

metrics.population_rule: Unique recorded AFCA-linked work seconds by phase at work time, divided by 3600.
metrics.unknown_rule: Unknown phase retained; unknown duration separate.

metrics.population_rule: Net paid remedy to snapshot for matters concluded in period divided by matters with known remedy/payment coverage, including supported zero amounts; shared obligations need explicit attribution.
metrics.unknown_rule: Concluded-cohort payments differ from payments-in-period and final awarded amounts; disclose excluded unknowns.

metrics.population_rule: Unique eligible work seconds times 7500 cents/hour /3600, rounded half-up per entry then summed; optional.
metrics.unknown_rule: Estimated capacity, never payroll or cash; duration provenance retained.
